entries.note: Imai 2013 PNAS abstract (PMID 23918359) quote verbatim; untested opener 2013. K14-IL-33 transgenic tied to no member drug: class/not_applicable right; unselected.
Smith 2017 PLoS Genet abstract quote verbatim; untested opener 2017. Human-genetic system tied to no drug: class/not_applicable right; unselected.
Chen 2019 accepted MS: 'single intravenous 300mg dose of etokimab' in 12 AD patients; abstract quote near (EASI)50 wording. Drug etokimab, route iv, unselected right; same holds.
Chen 2019 MS: HDM challenge 'four days after receiving either placebo or etokimab (300mg IV)'; quote near ('compared to', 'atopic dermatitis'). Etokimab iv right; same, comparison_stated true holds.

Etokimab 300 mg IV confirmed in Chen 2019 MS, which writes eosinophil reduction 'as predicted by genetic analysis of IL-33 loss-of-function', so comparison_stated could be true. Drug/route right; same holds.

Kosloski 2024 abstract (PMID 39077906, epub 2024-08-01) quote verbatim. CT.gov: REGN3500 SC q2w/q4w; registry results carry no IL-33/eosinophil data, so 2024 holds. First on itepekimab sc track: strengthens dropped right.
Salimi 2013 JEM abstract quote verbatim; knockout system states no exposure target: untested no_prediction holds; class/not_applicable right.
Hirota 2012 Nat Genet abstract clause quoted with ellipses; untested opener 2012. GWAS tied to no drug: class/not_applicable right.
Salimi 2013 quote verbatim; untested opener 2013 on the MC903 knockout track; class/not_applicable right.
Press release dated Nov. 08, 2019, quote verbatim; NCT03533751 all arms etokimab SC vs SC placebo, results 2023-05-24 agree. Drug etokimab, route sc right; contra, year 2019 hold.
Chen 2019 MS quote near ('human disease, including atopic dermatitis'). Untested opener on HDM track; route sc follows the ATLAS SC comparison it opens (challenge ran on IV etokimab): acceptable.
ATLAS press release quote verbatim, SC arms confirmed on CT.gov; contra on HDM-challenge track holds. Etokimab sc, unselected right.
ATLAS quote verbatim, SC confirmed; contra on genetics track holds at low confidence. Etokimab sc right.

Kosloski 2024 quote verbatim. NCT03736967: REGN3500 SC q2w monotherapy arm vs placebo, primary EASI % change wk16, whyStopped 'Lack of efficacy', results first posted 2021-11-01: year 2021, itepekimab sc, combination_with null right.
Okragly 2021 quote verbatim; full text states only specificity and cyno cross-reactivity for later NHP tox, no harm or margin. Torudokimab sc (NCT03831191) right; untested no_prediction holds.

entries.rule: Evidence rule 6 (dating: earliest public date incl. registry results posting)
entries.note: Kosloski 2024 quote verbatim; untested no_prediction right (torudokimab panel names no harm, never run for itepekimab), itepekimab sc right. But NCT03736967 posted itepekimab AE tables 2021-11-01, earlier than 2024 and than registry_date 2022-06-10.
entries.adjudication_note: Evidence rule 6: status untested (no_prediction) stands; NCT03736967 itepekimab results with AE tables posted 2021-11-01, so the entry dates 2021, not 2024.

entries.note: Peng 2018 Inflammation abstract (PMID 28952069) read; non-member anti-mouse IL-33 antibody, so class/not_applicable right. Untested opener 2017 holds.

Okragly 2021 (PMC full text) quote verbatim; NCT03831191 dosed LY3375880 SC Q4W: torudokimab sc right; no dosed-human IL-5, untested not_measured holds. retrodiction should be true (first public 2021, after Chen 2019 eosinophil result on IL-33).
Chen 2019 MS quote verbatim; ex-vivo opener. Patients compared got etokimab 300 mg IV: drug etokimab, route iv right; untested opener holds.

Chen 2019 MS: 'Given the clinical trial data implicating ... in vivo, we next tested whether etokimab could modulate neutrophil migration ex vivo' (healthy-donor blood). Run after: retro, retrodiction true right; iv right. Judgement text still says 'Scored same': stale.
Peng 2018 abstract: 'blockade of IL-33 has a curative effect on AD' verbatim; non-member anti-mouse antibody: class/not_applicable right; untested opener 2017.
ATLAS quote verbatim; etokimab SC confirmed; Peng model public 2017, before any patient result, so prospective. Contra holds; etokimab sc right.
NCT03831191 whyStopped verbatim; LY3375880 SC Q4W vs SC placebo; results 2021-04-20. Torudokimab sc right; first on torudokimab track, strengthens dropped right; contra holds.
DaSilva-Arnold 2018 abstract (epub 2018-01-24) quote verbatim; Stat6VT x IL-33 knockout tied to no drug: class/not_applicable right; untested opener 2018.

entries.rule: Status table: same needs agreement in direction; a predicted effect that never appeared is a wrong prediction (contra, magnitude opposite)
entries.note: ATLAS quote verbatim, etokimab SC confirmed: drug/route right. DaSilva-Arnold predicted worsening with IL-33 loss; ATLAS arms tracked placebo, no worsening. Direction not matched: contra, not same.
entries.adjudication_note: Status table (same needs agreement in direction): DaSilva-Arnold abstract says IL-33 loss made disease more severe; ATLAS arms tracked placebo, no worsening. Harm counted here, so unmet predicted effect is contra, magnitude opposite.

entries.note: Chen 2019 MS: serum IgE 10101 to 9954 (day 29) to 10321 (day 140) kU/L after one 300 mg IV dose; Peng DNCB mice lowered IgE. Etokimab iv right; contra low confidence unchanged.

missing: Peng 2018 (Inflammation, doi 10.1007/s10753-017-0673-7, PMID 28952069): anti-mouse-IL-33 antibody in DNCB-induced AD mice, 'blockade of IL-33 has a curative effect on AD' (abstract). A prospective pharmacological track (sibling antibody, product_in_model false) that predicted efficacy and was contradicted by ATLAS 2019; no track in the draft. The same paper also correlates serum IL-33/sST2 with human AD activity (comparison_stated in-source).

Pietka 2020 (Sci Rep, doi 10.1038/s41598-020-63410-z, PMID 32296080) as a retro entry on il33-st2-mouse-dermatitis, year 2020: received 2020-01-28, its introduction cites the NCT03533751 failure ('the fate of IL-33 inhibition in atopic dermatitis is therefore highly questionable'), and IL-33-/-, ST2-/- and double-knockout mice develop MC903 dermatitis like wild type. Decision 10 draws it on its track with retrodiction: true, not only in judgement.

DaSilva-Arnold 2018 (Arch Dermatol Res, doi 10.1007/s00403-018-1807-y, PMID 29368135, epub 2018-01-24): Stat6VT AD mice, 'AD-like disease was more severe in IL-33-deficient Stat6VT mice ... IL-33 may attenuate inflammation in this system'. A prospective pre-ATLAS model predicting no benefit (if anything harm) from IL-33 loss; candidate track scored same/partial on direction (no benefit seen, no worsening) or untested.

Okragly 2021 (doi 10.2147/JIR.S320287): torudokimab's own in vivo human-IL-33-induced pharmacodynamic inhibition assay in mice (IL-5 endpoint), a member drug's engagement model never compared with patient PD; an untested engagement track distinct from the cyno specificity/PK safety track.

Chen 2019 (doi 10.1126/scitranslmed.aax2945): 'etokimab also inhibited neutrophil migration to skin interstitial fluid in vitro', an ex_vivo human system compared in-source with the in vivo HDM challenge; candidate separate ex_vivo engagement track (same, comparison_stated true) rather than folded into the human_challenge track.

Laquer 2022 (Br J Dermatol, doi 10.1111/bjd.21631, PMID 35481678, epub 2022-07-29; Lilly authors incl. Okragly, Sims): tier-1 report of the torudokimab AD trial, 'Interleukin-33 antibody failed to demonstrate benefit in a phase II ... study'. Not a model, but a missed source: patient_trials NCT03831191 has doi null. No abstract (research letter); not opened, paywalled.

Checked and not applicable: England 2023 (Sci Rep, doi 10.1038/s41598-023-36642-y) tozorakimab characterization uses primary human cells and a murine lung epithelial-injury model, no skin or AD system; Imai 2019 (JID, 10.1016/j.jid.2019.04.016) is the same K14-IL-33 transgenic track already opened by Imai 2013.

models: Peng 2018 serum-IgE readout vs Chen 2019 full text (ORA accepted manuscript, https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:5e031a33-1e4d-4f51-b2e7-3c4001ee8f4d): 'There was no significant change in serum total IgE during the study (mean total serum IgE at study entry 10101+7594 kU/L; day 29 post-etokimab 9954+7394 kU/L; day 140 post-etokimab 10321+8103 kU/L)'. A missed engagement pairing on anti-il33-mab-dncb-mouse-ad: the model predicted serum IgE falls, 12 dosed AD patients showed none at day 29/140, while peripheral eosinophils fell 40% (lesional in the model). Candidate contra or same + partial, year 2019, low confidence (single open-label 300 mg dose, no placebo arm for IgE).

engagement, anti-il33-mab-dncb-mouse-ad: Kosloski 2024 (doi:10.1111/cts.13874) itepekimab AD PK/PD with repeated q2w/q4w dosing may report serum total IgE; a secondary listing says IgE reductions were 'more gradual'. Not confirmed it was itepekimab vs placebo; if so, a later same entry on this track.

rule_questions: A tier-5 press release dates the entry (2019) while a tier-3 registry record (2023-05-24) sets the status: which document is `src`/`source_tier`, and does `trial_unreported` stay true once a registry results record exists?

Decision 10 vs decision 6: may a `retro` entry be appended to a track already `contra` (Pietka 2020 on the IL-33/ST2 knockout MC903 track), and does a same-system re-run that overturns the model's earlier result count as the model 'reproducing the human data' or as a model-replication failure?

Decision 7 when the registry results record lacks the datum the comparison rests on (NCT03738423 posts functional PK only; total-IL-33 saturation and eosinophils first appear in Kosloski 2024): does the registry date still set `year` for the dose and engagement entries?

Is a GWAS locus shared by three receptor genes (IL1RL1-IL18R1-IL18RAP) with the causal gene unresolved an admissible class prediction for anti-IL-33 (`contra`) or `untested`; and what does `product_in_model` mean on a human_genetic track?

Safety: can a member-specific specificity panel plus cyno PK (torudokimab) be paired with another member's tolerability (itepekimab) when decision 12 pools only on-target harms; and is a specificity statement a 'stated prediction' of no harm at all, or is the cell `untested`?
#127 defines `strengthens: true` for a second miss; is it allowed on a same-to-same engagement entry (Kosloski 2024 direct readout), or should that datum go in `patient_trials`?

models: efficacy, a prospective model whose stated prediction was worsening (DaSilva-Arnold: IL-33 attenuates Stat6VT disease) when patients showed a null (ATLAS arms ~ placebo): same on the no-benefit half (direction_only), contra by #58/decision 4 (predicted effect absent), or an efficacy analogue of decision 5's over-prediction? Under decision 6 the answer sets the tile's efficacy headline.

models: decision 10 for an ex-vivo assay inside the trial paper itself, run after and 'given the clinical trial data' (Chen 2019 transwells on trial blister fluid): retro as proposed, and does a track that only ever retrodicted still open with an untested entry (#30/#112)?

models: rule 7 proxy dating for a candidate-selection PD assay published four years after first-in-human (Okragly 2021; FIH Nov 2017): open the untested strip at publication (2021, as the draft's cyno track) or at first class use with the paper as proxy (2017)?

engagement 11: the DNCB model dosed antibody 14 times over 33 days; Chen gave one 300 mg dose. Is a single-dose null on a slow-turnover readout (IgE) a contra, or untested because the dosing regimen differs from the model's?
